notes.title: Improved Gameplay and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We're excited to release our latest patch update for Fright Knight Legend, featuring several improvements and bug fixes. We've fixed a bug that previously prevented players from running when their stamina was out, so you can now sprint to your heart's content. We've also added support for 5:4, 16:9, and 21:9 screen sizes, giving you more options to customize your gameplay experience. Additionally, we've resolved a bug in the Grasslands BOSS level that previously kept some players from progressing. We hope you enjoy these changes and look forward to your continued support for Fright Knight Legend!

Hint: When you're playing the game and low on lives & energy, use this code to get a pick me up!

Pause the game and the press
JJJBBBJJJ
J=Jump
B=Block

You will then have your lives, energy and stamina refilled.

notes.title: Enemy AI patch
notes.content: Updated the Enemy AI so when the player gets knocked down, the player is not ganged up on as easily.

notes.title: Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
* Updated the Enemy AI to be more balanced in combat when knocked down
* Optimized the Grasslands level with grass
* Added a cheat code 

For the Demo
* The demo plays through the entire Graveyard stage.

BONUS - here's a cheat code:

Restore Energy and Lives to full for each player

Key Combo when you pause the game- JJJBBBJJJ

J=Jump
B=Block

You should hear a beep when you do it right. Have fun!

notes.title: Optimization to Intro & Walkway Cut Scene
notes.content: We updated the cut scenes for the Intro & Walkway to be better optimized for lower end machines.

notes.title: Added a "Disable Mid Game Story" and other updates
notes.content:
Added a "Disable Mid Game Story" option during gameplay if you are one of the players who want to have less story and more action during the gameplay (the BOSS storyline is still intact).

Fixed the timing issue when the game is unpaused - it's back to being fast paced!

Added 5:4 support for those playing the game on old school monitors. 

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047481/39bb8b1545f57dc7dc666584a7f753e189e06f4f.png[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay is 30% faster for INTENSE ACTION! UltraWideScreen added, & more
notes.content:
MAJOR update on the game speed - the gameplay itself runs 30% faster than before, meaning MORE INTENSE ACTION! We felt this feature would give the game a lot more excitement to the gameplay!

Also added UltraWideScreen support for the game, so if you run the game on a Ultra Wide Monitor, it should now take full advantage of your Ultra Wide Screen monitor.

Other FX added to the enemies when they appear on screen for some eye candy. Other minor fixes & adjustments.

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047481/60bdb809511ab9524ecc281001916958af6ee6cf.png[/img]

notes.title: Balancing start of the levels, added an Audio & Video Settings in the Main Menu
notes.content:
Balanced some of the levels, added an Audio & Video Settings menu. The beginning of the levels have been adjusted so it's not as difficult in the first few waves, and added some more health along the way. Added a video & audio settings in Main Menu where you can change what monitor the game plays on and adjust audio settings. 

Coming soon, more settings are in the works and may have some updates with gameplay.
